question: Why are equipotential surfaces always perpendicular to electric field lines? Justify your answer without using a diagram.

options.A: The potential is constant along an equipotential surface, so $\Delta V=0$ and the field has no component along the surface; hence it is perpendicular
options.B: Electric field lines must be tangential to equipotential surfaces to keep potential constant
options.C: Equipotential surfaces are perpendicular to field lines only at the origin
options.D: Equipotential surfaces are perpendicular because charge cannot move across them
